topic: Tenses – Past Progressive: Negations in the Past Progressive
title: Past Progressive: Negative Sentences

explanation.tr:
Past Progressive, geçmişte belli bir anda devam eden eylemleri anlatır.
Olumsuz biçim:
• I / he / she / it + wasn't (was not) + fiil-ing
• you / we / they + weren't (were not) + fiil-ing
• I wasn't sleeping at 11 pm. (Gece 11'de uyumuyordum.)
• They weren't listening when the teacher explained it.
explanation.tk:
Past Progressive geçmişde belli bir pursatda dowam eden hereketleri aňladýar.
Ýokluk görnüşi:
• I / he / she / it + wasn't (was not) + işlik-ing
• you / we / they + weren't (were not) + işlik-ing
• I wasn't sleeping at 11 pm. (Gije sagat 11-de men ýatamokdym.)
• They weren't listening when the teacher explained it.
explanation.ru:
Past Progressive описывает действие, длившееся в определённый момент в прошлом.
Отрицание:
• I / he / she / it + wasn't (was not) + глагол-ing
• you / we / they + weren't (were not) + глагол-ing
• I wasn't sleeping at 11 pm. (В 11 вечера я не спал.)
• They weren't listening when the teacher explained it.

examples.en: I wasn't working at that time.
examples.ru: В то время я не работал.

examples.en: She wasn't wearing a coat.
We weren't watching TV when you called.
examples.tk: Sen jaň edeniňde biz telewizor görmeýärdik.
examples.ru: Когда ты позвонил, мы не смотрели телевизор.

examples.en: It wasn't raining in the morning.
They weren't paying attention.
He wasn't driving fast.

exercises.question: Find the mistake: "My parents wasn't sleeping."

topic: Tenses – Past Progressive: Past Progressive – Statements
title: Past Progressive: Positive Statements

explanation.tr:
Past Progressive: was / were + fiil-ing
• I / he / she / it → was: I was reading.
• you / we / they → were: They were dancing.
Kullanım:
• Geçmişte belli bir anda devam eden eylem: At 8 pm I was having dinner.
• Uzun eylem + kısa eylem (when ile): I was walking home when it started to rain.
• Aynı anda iki uzun eylem (while ile): While I was cooking, he was cleaning.
explanation.tk:
Past Progressive: was / were + işlik-ing
• I / he / she / it → was: I was reading.
• you / we / they → were: They were dancing.
Ulanylyşy:
• Geçmişde belli bir pursatda dowam eden hereket: At 8 pm I was having dinner.
• Uzak hereket + gysga hereket (when bilen): I was walking home when it started to rain.
• Bir wagtda iki uzak hereket (while bilen): While I was cooking, he was cleaning.
explanation.ru:
Past Progressive: was / were + глагол-ing
• I / he / she / it → was: I was reading.
• you / we / they → were: They were dancing.
Употребление:
• Действие в процессе в определённый момент прошлого: At 8 pm I was having dinner.
• Длительное + короткое действие (с when): I was walking home when it started to rain.
• Два длительных действия одновременно (с while): While I was cooking, he was cleaning.

examples.en: At 8 pm I was having dinner.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.tk: Ýagyş başlanda men öýe pyýada barýardym.
examples.ru: Я шёл домой, когда начался дождь.

topic: Tenses – Past Progressive: Questions and short answers in the Past Progressive
title: Past Progressive: Questions and Short Answers

explanation.tr:
Past Progressive soru: Was/Were + özne + fiil-ing?
• Was she sleeping? Were they working?
• Kısa cevaplar:
  Yes, I/he/she/it was. / No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
  Yes, you/we/they were. / No, you/we/they weren't.
• Örnek: Were you watching TV at 9? – No, I wasn't. I was reading.
explanation.tk:
Past Progressive sorag: Was/Were + eýe + işlik-ing?
• Was she sleeping? Were they working?
• Gysga jogaplar:
  Yes, I/he/she/it was. / No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
  Yes, you/we/they were. / No, you/we/they weren't.
• Mysal: Were you watching TV at 9? – No, I wasn't. I was reading.
explanation.ru:
Вопрос в Past Progressive: Was/Were + подлежащее + глагол-ing?
• Was she sleeping? Were they working?
• Краткие ответы:
  Yes, I/he/she/it was. / No, I/he/she/it wasn't.
  Yes, you/we/they were. / No, you/we/they weren't.
• Пример: Were you watching TV at 9? – No, I wasn't. I was reading.

examples.en: Were you sleeping? – Yes, I was.
Was it raining? – No, it wasn't.
Were they studying? – Yes, they were.
Was he driving? – No, he wasn't.
Was your mum working yesterday? – Yes, she was.
Were we making too much noise? – No, you weren't.

topic: Tenses – Past Progressive: Questions in the Past Progressive
title: Past Progressive: Wh-Questions

explanation.tr:
Soru kelimeli Past Progressive soruları:
• Soru kelimesi + was/were + özne + fiil-ing?
  What were you doing at 10 o'clock? Where was she going? Why were they laughing?
• Who özne ise: Who was talking? (Kim konuşuyordu?)
• Polis sorusu gibi: What were you doing last night at 9 pm?
explanation.tk:
Sorag sözli Past Progressive soraglary:
• Sorag sözi + was/were + eýe + işlik-ing?
  What were you doing at 10 o'clock? Where was she going? Why were they laughing?
• Who eýe bolsa: Who was talking? (Kim gürleýärdi?)
• Polisiýanyň soragy ýaly: What were you doing last night at 9 pm?
explanation.ru:
Специальные вопросы в Past Progressive:
• Вопросительное слово + was/were + подлежащее + глагол-ing?
  What were you doing at 10 o'clock? Where was she going? Why were they laughing?
• Если Who — подлежащее: Who was talking? (Кто разговаривал?)
• Как вопрос полицейского: What were you doing last night at 9 pm?

examples.en: What were you doing at 10 o'clock?
Where was she going?
Why were they laughing?
Who was talking during the test?
What was he wearing?
How fast were you driving?

topic: Tenses – Past Progressive: Sentences and questions in the Past Progressive
title: Past Progressive: Mixed Practice

explanation.tr:
Past Progressive'in tüm biçimlerini birlikte çalış:
• Olumlu: She was reading a book.
• Olumsuz: She wasn't reading a book.
• Soru: Was she reading a book?
• Wh-soru: What was she reading?
• Simple Past ile birlikte: She was reading when I arrived.
  (Uzun eylem → Past Progressive, kesen kısa eylem → Simple Past)
explanation.tk:
Past Progressive-iň ähli görnüşlerini bilelikde türgenleş:
• Tassyklaýjy: She was reading a book.
• Ýokluk: She wasn't reading a book.
• Sorag: Was she reading a book?
• Wh-sorag: What was she reading?
• Simple Past bilen bilelikde: She was reading when I arrived.
  (Uzak hereket → Past Progressive, ony kesýän gysga hereket → Simple Past)
explanation.ru:
Тренируй все формы Past Progressive вместе:
• Утверждение: She was reading a book.
• Отрицание: She wasn't reading a book.
• Вопрос: Was she reading a book?
• Специальный вопрос: What was she reading?
• Вместе с Simple Past: She was reading when I arrived.
  (Длительное действие → Past Progressive, короткое прерывающее → Simple Past)

examples.en: She was reading when I arrived.
Was she reading a novel?
What was she reading?
We weren't expecting visitors.
The phone rang while I was having a shower.
